If you're looking for a easy and automated way to evaluate individuals, scored quizzes are the perfect solution. 
These **[online quizzes](/templates/categories/quizzes/)** let you give points for each answer. The software then calculates the total score for each person automatically. 

This scoring system can be used to provide personalized results. These may include performance ratings, custom feedback, or certificates based on results. 

In this guide, we will show you how to create a scored quiz using Formester. We will also explain how to **[set up different outcomes based on scores](/blog/how-to-create-an-outcome-quiz/)**.

## Getting Started with Formester
To begin, **[log in to your Formester account](https://app.formester.com/users/sign_in)**. From the dashboard, click on "**New Form.**" 

Here, you have the option to create your quiz manually or utilize the **[AI Quiz Maker](/ai-quiz-maker/)**.

### Creating Your Quiz
<iframe width="813" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/DcEtkYUML_8?si=rJEjqlLy1XfSvDhw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Once you've selected the AI Quiz Builder, choose "**Scored Quiz**." You can then input a simple prompt, such as "**Generate a math quiz with the following questions, answers, and scores**." 

After entering your questions and desired points for each answer, click on "**Generate Form**." The AI will create a quiz with single-choice fields based on your inputs.

It's essential to check the scoring assignments to ensure they are configured correctly.

### Assigning Scores to Questions
To verify and set up scoring, navigate to the "**Advanced**" section and select "**Form Control**." Click on "**Score Quiz**" to access the scoring UI. 

Here, you can toggle on options such as "**Show Feedback**," which displays the correct answer when a user submits an incorrect response. 

You can also enable or disable the option to allow users to edit their answers. Another feature is "**Allow Multiple Variables**," which permits different scoring values for each answer option across various questions. 

Save the changes once you've finalized the scoring assignments.

### Creating Thank You Pages
To show different outcomes based on the overall score, you must create three distinct thank you pages. Name them accordingly: "**Thank You - Beginner**," "**Thank You - Intermediate**," and "**Thank You - Expert.**" Customize each page with a relevant message and any additional information you want to convey.

To display the respondent's score on the thank you page, you can use a variable. Simply click on the thank you page field and utilize the "**@**" sign followed by the variable name "**score**" to display the total score achieved by the user. 

You can also improve these thank you pages by adding images through the image toggle feature, choosing between your own uploads or Unsplash images.

### Redirecting Based on Score
Next, we need to set up **[conditional logic](/blog/what-is-conditional-logic-how-to-use-it/)** to redirect users to the appropriate thank you page based on their scores.

This can be done under "**Form Control**" in the "**Rules**" section. Click on "**Add Rule**" to create conditional rules that dictate which thank you page to display based on the total score.

For instance, you may set the rule: If the score is greater than 0 and less than 14, redirect to the "Thank You - Beginner" page. 

Similarly, create rules for the other outcomes: if the score is between 15 and 23, redirect to "Thank You - Intermediate," and if the score is 24 or higher, redirect to "Thank You - Expert." After creating all necessary rules, hit save.

### Testing Your Quiz
With everything set up, it's time to test your quiz. Change the theme to your preference and hit "Publish." Start answering the quiz questions and track the outcomes based on your responses. 

For instance, if you answer all questions correctly, you should see the "**Thank You - Expert**" page. 

Conversely, if you score lower, the corresponding thank you page should reflect that score.

### Summary
Creating a scored quiz in **[Formester](/)** is an easy way to evaluate individuals while providing personalized feedback. 

By following the steps outlined in this guide, you can set up a quiz that not only scores responses but also delivers tailored outcomes based on performance.

Whether you’re looking to assess knowledge, provide recommendations, or issue certificates, scored quizzes can serve as a valuable tool in your evaluation toolkit.
 
**[Start today with Formester](https://app.formester.com/users/sign_up)** and explore the potential of interactive assessments!
